observations.what: Sign-up from the free pricing plan needed name, email, organization, terms checkbox, an hCaptcha, then a separate password page with a second hCaptcha.
No verification email was required to enter the product; the only mail that arrived was a welcome/help message.
The onboarding page offered a 'Skip the tour' link for existing Basecamp users, which got straight to Home.
The free plan allows only 1 project, shown as 'My Project', which starts empty with just a plus button and no task or status template.
Adding the To-dos tool first opened a title-rename form before any to-do could be added, an extra step.
The To-dos list took a name in one field and added the item inline; ticking the checkbox marks a to-do done, which gives a simple status view.
The tool menu offers a Card Table described as tracking work with cards and columns, a fit for project statuses.
I clicked a Card Table entry that was in a hidden menu and nothing happened; I had to reopen the plus menu.
